issues.description: The Farm.singFarmSong method has a return type mismatch across artifacts: the UML and problem text describe/expect a method that prints the song (void), the template declares public void singFarmSong(), but the solution implements public String singFarmSong() and returns the composed song text. This discrepancy can confuse students about whether to print to System.out or return a String, and may cause test or grading mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the API across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to match the specification/template by making singFarmSong() return void and print the verses to System.out, or (B) update the problem statement and template to specify that singFarmSong() returns a String (and adjust wording from "prints" to "returns the song text") so the solution's signature is correct. Ensure singFarmSong's contract is consistent in the UML, problem text, template, and solution.

issues.description: The helper method singFarmSongVerse has a parameter/signature mismatch: the UML and solution expect a private method taking an Animal parameter, but the template declares private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/) with the parameter commented out (no parameter). Additionally, the solution's helper returns a String while the UML/template indicate a void helper that prints. This inconsistency can confuse students about the expected helper signature and return behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method signature consistent across artifacts. Add the Animal parameter to the template signature (e.g., private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) or, if following the solution approach, update the template and problem statement to define the helper as returning a String (private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)). Ensure the UML, problem text, template, and solution agree on both the parameter list and whether the helper prints or returns the verse text.
